integrity: Exact symbolic identities, direct kernel-area proof, and a standalone rational/symbolic checker included. Published literature is cited with dates verified from first arXiv postings; no third-party papers are embedded.
scientific_limitations: Only three distinct knots, degree-one continuous periodic splines, and unweighted arclength. The all-positive-mesh upper bound is strict and the supremum is approached through degenerating meshes. No independent mathematical audit or absolute historical uniqueness certification is claimed.
title: Sharp three-knot periodic linear-spline projection bound
